properties.IncidentOverview: A lightning storm moved through Eastern Oregon on July 15; 2026; igniting multiple fires. The Egypt Fire was discovered on the morning of July 16; 2026. Initial attack resources from the Burns Interagency Fire Zone responded promptly but were spread thin due to several other starts in the area. Southern Area Team 2 took command of the Egypt Fire on July 19 at 6 AM. Priorities remain public and firefighter safety; private lands; and critical infrastructure. Firefighters are working the fire as directly as possible to protect these values at risk; using both ground resources and multiple helicopters and fixed wing aircraft.

properties.Location: 50 Miles SW of Mountain Home, ID
properties.IncidentOverview: On July 23; 2026; the U.S. Wildland Fire Service Great Basin Unit 1 in Boise; ID; in close coordination with the BLM Boise District; responded to several lightning-caused fires across the unit. One of these starts was the Duncan Fire; located approximately 35 miles south of Bruneau; ID. Great Basin Complex Incident Management Team 3 took over management of the fire on July 24; 2026.
